Full attendance and active engagement are required throughout this period.   **Core Hours (After Training):**   Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM local time (subject to operational needs).   **Key Responsibilities**   * Evaluate and monitor transactional activity to identify potential suspicious activity. * Verify client identities and assess their relationships with financial institutions for Know your Customer (KYC) purposes. * Interpret and implement client\-operating policies related to financial data. * Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review. * Write clear, concise reports summarizing findings and recommendations. * Use basic Excel functions and technology applications (Microsoft, internet) for analysis. * Adhere to designated timeframes and procedures to ensure timely and accurate completion of tasks. * Submit written work product for review by internal quality control teams and make necessary adjustments based on feedback. * Meet production and quality standards while working collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment. * Ensure compliance with federal and state laws, regulations and company policies, and client requirements related to Anti\-Money Laundering.   **Qualifications**   * **Bachelor’s Degree required.** * Must reside within 40 miles of either the Highland Hills (23000 Millcreek Blvd, Highland Hills, OH 44122\) or Cleveland (1300 E 9th Street, Suite 200, Cleveland, OH 44114\) office. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to learn quickly. * Analytical mindset with attention to detail and organizational skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with other Office tools. * Ability to adapt to feedback, work independently, and identify process improvements. * Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, filtering, sorting) and strong research skills are a plus.   **Compensation \& Benefits**   * Starting at $40,000, with an increase to $42,000 after the initial 90\-day probationary period, contingent upon meeting performance expectations. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits * Paid time off and holidays * Professional development opportunities * Collaborative work environment with global exposure   **About Us**     AML RightSource is the leading technology\-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, we operate globally as a trusted partner to financial institutions, FinTechs, and corporations.       Our team of 7,000\+ compliance professionals combines expertise, technology, and consulting to help clients with AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, KYC, EDD, and risk management. Together, we are Reimagining Compliance.       AML RightSource,LLC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.     AML RightSource may use AI tools to support candidate screening; however, all hiring decisions are made through human review.       We are committed to providing accommodations to individuals with disabilities throughout all aspects of the recruitment process. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment and selection process, please email hiring@amlrightsource.com or discuss your needs when contacted for an interview.   **AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   **Recruitment Scam Alerts**   **We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e\-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job\-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

jobs.title: MDS Medical Affairs Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
**Job ID** R\-534317 **Date posted** 12/25/2025

**Job Description Summary**

===========================

 

**Job Description**

===================

 

 

We are **the makers of possible**

 

 

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

 

 

We believe that the human element, across our global teams, is what allows us to continually evolve. Join us and discover an environment in which you’ll be supported to learn, grow and become your best self. Become a **maker of possible** with us.

 

**Job Summary:**

 

 

The Strategy Manager will support the MDS Global Medical Affairs Strategy by performing tactical initiatives in early innovation, evidence dissemination, global KOL engagement, and insights generation that drive organizational success. This role reports directly to the Associate Director, Strategy, Medical Affairs, and is designed to operate and extend strategic objectives into day\-to\-day deliverables.

 

 

To excel in this role, the incumbent must have the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and partners, using diverse perspectives to achieve shared project goals and cultivate an inclusive work environment. Taking ownership of assigned projects and tasks, maintaining clear accountability and strong follow\-through to ensure timely, high\-quality completion of deliverables will be necessary.

 

 

The ideal candidate blends deep clinical knowledge with collaboration in the translation of data into meaningful insights, value message generation, evidence interpretation and actionable deliverables that support both internal collaborators and external healthcare providers. While contributing to strategic planning in a guided and collaborative capacity, this position emphasizes execution and follow\-through on projects led by the Associate Director. The strategy manager Demonstrates flexibility and practical problem\-solving when facing changing priorities or challenging situations, remaining solutions focused in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment. Acting with integrity and professionalism, consistently doing what is right and building trust while accomplishing job responsibilities while maintaining the BD Way will be key.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

*General*

 

* Contributes to both short\-term and long\-term strategic planning for the MDS Medical Affairs function by providing analysis and operational input to ensure plans are well\-informed and executable.

* Assists in developing and refining the methodologies for capturing and sharing customer insights across MDS and the greater BD organization.

* Supports efforts to enhance engagement with key external experts (KOLs), using insights to help implement MDS business objectives (e.g., expanding utilization of current products and driving innovation).

* In collaboration with MDS Commercial and R\&D teams, aids in development and implementation of processes to increase customer engagement, gather insights, enhance scientific exchange, and support continuous clinical education.

* Contributes to cross\-functional partnerships between Medical Affairs, Commercial, Regulatory and R\&D, and supports the development of strategic alliances with key academic centers, professional societies, and industry partners to align with MDS business objectives and accelerate innovation.

 

*Innovation Support and Insight Identification:*

 

* Partner with internal stakeholders to support early innovation projects, including emerging innovation scanning, reviewing clinical guidelines and market trends, and conducting pipeline assessments to ensure new opportunities authentically fit organizational needs.

* Prepare background research, competitor intelligence, and clinical landscape assessments to inform Medical Affairs input into innovation planning.

* Coordinate input across Medical Affairs, R\&D, and Marketing to ensure innovation projects address genuine unmet clinical needs and remain aligned with broader strategic goals.

* Collect, analyze, and synthesize insights from literature, clinicians, advisory boards, and customer engagements to inform innovative efforts and strategic decision\-making.

 

*Evidence Dissemination:*

 

* Support the execution of the MDS platform evidence dissemination strategy for key evidence\-related activities, helping to boost product adoption and drive practice enhancements on a global level.

* Translate complex data into impactful presentations, intelligence reports, public evidence summaries, conference feedback, and other business inputs that are critical for advancing organizational priorities.

* Help plan and coordinate MDS collaborative engagements (e.g. advisory meetings, workshops) focused on evidence dissemination initiatives, ensuring alignment and communication across participants.

 

*Global KOL Engagement:*

 

* Maintain a KOL dashboard to track engagement metrics and the development of key partnerships at both individual and organizational levels including internal teams such as Medical Affairs, R\&D, and Commercial teams.

* Assist Platform Commercial and Medical Affairs partners in KOL engagement activities (including advisory boards and other scientific forums) to ensure alignment with strategic initiatives.

* Assist in the identification of trends in clinical practice, competitive positioning, and guideline updates relevant to MDS platforms, and communicate these findings to inform strategy and tactics.

 

**Minimum requirements:**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in a Healthcare field.

* 5 \+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical, Strategy or Marketing role(s) within the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.

* Demonstrated experience in both clinical/scientific communication and commercial alignment.

* Experience tailoring content for both scientific and business audiences.

* Strong digital fluency with working knowledge of technologies ranging from augmented reality for education/engagement to data visualization tools for insights generation and reporting.

* Experience taking accountability for deliverables and driving projects to completion.

* Balance of scientific/clinical understanding with strong commercial acumen.

* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and the ability to adjust priorities based on shifting objectives.

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

 

* Advanced degrees (Nursing, Pharmacy, or related healthcare field)

* Strong Experience in project management, managing multiple initiatives across global teams.

* Experience supporting KOL engagement, advisory boards, or medical education programs

 

 

At BD, we prioritize on\-site collaboration because we believe it fosters creativity, innovation, and effective problem\-solving, which are essential in the fast\-paced healthcare industry. For most roles, we require a minimum of 4 days of in\-office presence per week to maintain our culture of excellence and ensure smooth operations, while also recognizing the importance of flexibility and work\-life balance. Remote or field\-based positions will have different workplace arrangements which will be indicated in the job posting.

 

 

For certain roles at BD, employment is contingent upon the Company’s receipt of sufficient proof that you are fully vaccinated against COVID\-19\. In some locations, testing for COVID\-19 may be available and/or required. Consistent with BD’s Workplace Accommodations Policy, requests for accommodation will be considered pursuant to applicable law.

 

**Pay Transparency Statement:**

 

 

At BD, we are committed to supporting our associates’ well\-being, development, and success through a performance\-based culture. For this position, BD offers a competitive compensation package along with the following benefits specific to this role:

 

* Annual Bonus

* Potential Discretionary LTI Bonus

 

 

Health and Well\-being Benefits

 

* Medical coverage

* Health Savings Accounts

* Flexible Spending Accounts

* Dental coverage

* Vision coverage

* Hospital Care Insurance

* Critical Illness Insurance

* Accidental Injury Insurance

* Life and AD\&D insurance

* Short\-term disability coverage

* Long\-term disability insurance

* Long\-term care with life insurance

 

 

Other Well\-being Resources

 

* Anxiety management program

* Wellness incentives

* Sleep improvement program

* Diabetes management program

* Virtual physical therapy

* Emotional/mental health support programs

* Weight management programs

* Gastrointestinal health program

* Substance use management program

* Musculoskeletal surgery, cancer treatment, and bariatric surgery benefit

 

 

Retirement and Financial Well\-being

 

* BD 401(k) Plan

* BD Deferred Compensation and Restoration Plan

* 529 College Savings Plan

* Financial counseling

* Baxter Credit Union (BCU)

* Daily Pay

* College financial aid and application guidance

 

 

Life Balance Programs

 

* Paid time off (PTO), including all required State leaves

* Educational assistance/tuition reimbursement

* MetLife Legal Plan

* Group auto and home insurance

* Pet insurance

* Commuter benefits

* Discounts on products and services

* Academic Achievement Scholarship

* Service Recognition Awards

* Employer matching donation

* Workplace accommodations

 

 

Other Life Balance Programs

 

* Adoption assistance

* Backup day care and eldercare

* Support for neurodivergent adults, children, and caregivers

* Caregiving assistance for elderly and special needs individuals

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Paid Parental Leave

* Support for fertility, birthing, postpartum, and age\-related hormonal changes

 

 

Leave Programs

 

* Bereavement leaves

* Military leave

* Personal leave

* Family and Medical Leave (FML)

* Jury and Witness Duty Leave

 

**Why Join Us?**

 

 

A career at BD means being part of a team that values your opinions and contributions and that encourages you to bring your authentic self to work. It’s also a place where we help each other be great, we do what’s right, we hold each other accountable, and learn and improve every day.

 

 

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of health. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow, and thrive. And find satisfaction in doing your part to make the world a better place.

 

 

To learn more about BD visit https://bd.com/careers

 

 

Becton, Dickinson, and Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, and other legally\-protected characteristics.

 

 

Required Skills

 

 

Optional Skills

 

 

.

 

**Primary Work Location**

=========================

 

 

USA NJ \- Franklin Lakes**Additional Locations**

========================

 

**Work Shift**

==============

 

 

At BD, we are strongly committed to investing in our associates—their well\-being and development, and in providing rewards and recognition opportunities that promote a performance\-based culture. We demonstrate this commitment by offering a valuable, competitive package of compensation and benefits programs which you can learn more about on our Careers Site under Our Commitment to You.

 

 

Salary or hourly rate ranges have been implemented to reward associates fairly and competitively, as well as to support recognition of associates’ progress, ranging from entry level to experts in their field, and talent mobility. There are many factors, such as location, that contribute to the range displayed. The salary or hourly rate offered to a successful candidate is based on experience, education, skills, and any step rate pay system of the actual work location, as applicable to the role or position. Salary or hourly pay ranges may vary for Field\-based and Remote roles.

 

**Salary Range Information**

 

 

$132,400\.00 \- $218,400\.00 USD Annual

jobs.title: Licensed Medicare Agent (Indiana) – Build Monthly Residual Income
jobs.description:
**Licensed Medicare Agent (Indiana) – Build Monthly Residual Income**

 

**Location:** Indianapolis, Indiana (could potentially become remote if you prove yourself to be trustworthy and reliable)

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Compensation:** $200/week base \+ commissions \+ monthly residual income

**Income Potential:** Uncapped \| Performance\-Based

 

**This Role Is for Builders — Not Clock\-Punchers**

 

If you’re a **licensed Indiana Medicare agent** who’s tired of:

 

* One\-time commissions

* Starting over every enrollment season

* Doing everything yourself

 

This opportunity was built for you.

 

We are looking for someone who wants a **long\-term home**, a **seat at the table**, and the ability to build **real monthly residual income** by combining Medicare sales with a fast\-growing support services division.

 

This is not a quick\-win job.

This *is* a path to financial freedom for the right person.

 

**How You Get Paid (Clear \& Honest)Weekly Base**

 

* **$200 per week**

 

(Low by design — the upside is in ownership\-style income)

 

**Medicare Sales**

 

* **$200** per Medicare Advantage enrollment (new to Medicare)

* **$100** per plan change

 

✔ Leads are **pre\-called by our staff**

✔ You receive **warm transfers**

✔ You may also **call lead lists** to increase volume

 

**The Real Opportunity: Monthly Residual Income**

 

In addition to Medicare sales, we operate a **Personal Virtual Assistant (VA) division** that supports Independent Medicare Agents.

 

These agents desperately need help — and we offer the **lowest\-priced full\-time assistants in the industry**.

 

For **every VA sold**, you earn:

 

* **$200–$300 per month**

* Paid **every month**

* As long as the VA remains employed

* **No cap. No limit. No reset.**

 

**Example of how this stacks (not guaranteed):**

 

* 10 VAs → $2,000–$3,000/month

* 25 VAs → $5,000–$7,500/month

* 50 VAs → $10,000–$15,000/month

* 100\+ VAs → $20,000–$30,000\+/month

 

With consistency, retention, and time, **top performers may potentially reach $60,000 per month or more within approximately two years**.

 

This is how leverage is built.

 

**Why This Sells Easily**

 

* Independent Medicare Agents are overwhelmed

* They need help with:

* Calling leads

* Booking appointments

* Inbound calls

* Emails \& customer service

* Client retention \& admin work

* We provide **40 hours/week for as low as $1,100/month**

* That’s roughly **$6\.87/hour**

* Demand is high. Resistance is low.

 

**What You’ll Do Day\-to\-Day**

 

* Sell **Medicare Advantage plans**

* Make **outbound calls** to increase your personal production

* Receive **warm inbound transfers** from our calling team

* Provide **customer service support** for existing Medicare clients

* Help sell **Personal Virtual Assistants** to Independent Medicare Agents

* Assist in **training VAs** so they deliver excellent service

* Work directly with leadership to grow both divisions long\-term

 

You’re not just selling — you’re helping build systems that pay you every month.**What We Give You**

 

✔ Lead lists

✔ Warm transfers

✔ Your own **personal assistant**

✔ Training, scripts, and support

✔ Multiple income streams

✔ Long\-term residual income

✔ No income ceiling

 

**Who This Is For**

 

* Licensed Indiana Medicare agents

* Strong communicators who are comfortable on the phone

* People who want **ownership\-style income**, not hourly pay

* Agents who think in **12–24 month timelines**

* Builders who want stability, leverage, and freedom

 

**Important Disclosure**

 

This role offers **performance\-based compensation with uncapped earning potential**.

Earnings examples are **not guarantees** and depend on individual effort, consistency, sales ability, and retention. Results will vary.

 

**Apply Today**

 

If you’re serious about building something long\-term — and you’re willing to put in the work up front to create freedom later — we want to hear from you.

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract, Permanent

jobs.title: Appointment Setter (SDR) (Commission-Only / Paid on Closed Deals Only)
jobs.description:
NorthStar Agents — Appointment Setter (SDR) (Commission\-Only / Paid on Closed Deals Only)

 

**Role Title:** Appointment Setter / Sales Development Representative (SDR)

**Job Type:** 100% Commission\-Only (No base pay, no hourly)

**Location:** Flexible (in\-person outreach and/or phone/remote)

**Compensation:** Paid **only on closed deals that are collected**

**Reports To:** NorthStar Agents Leadership

 

About NorthStar Agents

 

NorthStar Agents builds secure, human\-governed AI\-assisted systems for businesses and regulated environments. We deliver custom websites, partner portals, admin panels, workflow automations, and AI phone agents (receptionist \+ sales/appointment agents).

 

Role Summary

 

We’re hiring a commission\-only **Appointment Setter (SDR)** to generate opportunities and book qualified meetings that convert into paying clients. You can prospect **in person or over the phone**—whatever works—so long as you consistently create real opportunities and help move them to close.

 

**Important:** This role is **paid on closed deals only**. If a deal doesn’t close and payment isn’t collected, there is no payout.

 

What You’ll Do

 

* Prospect and generate leads (walk\-ins, door\-to\-door, cold calls, networking, referrals you generate, email/DM outreach)

* Identify decision\-makers and qualify prospects

* Book discovery calls/meetings for NorthStar Agents (and ensure the right person shows up)

* Capture and submit accurate lead details for a clean handoff

* Follow up to keep leads warm and moving toward a decision

* Update lead status in the pipeline tracker/CRM

 

What You’ll Sell (Booked Meetings For)

 

* AI phone agents (answer calls 24/7, book appointments, capture leads)

* Websites and web rebuilds

* Partner portals \+ admin panels (connected systems)

* Workflow automations and integrations

* Monthly maintenance/support packages

 

Compensation (Closed Deals Only)

 

**You are paid only when the client pays. No base pay.**

 

Commission Structure

 

* **5% of the first payment collected** on any deal you source

 

(deposit or first invoice payment—must clear)

 

Optional (if included by NorthStar Agents)

 

* **1% of the client’s Monthly Maintenance Fee (MRC)** collected, paid monthly for up to **12 months**, only for deals you sourced and only while the account is active and in good standing.

 

**Commission is calculated on net revenue collected** (after refunds/chargebacks).

 

Lead Credit \& Rules (To Keep It Fair)

 

A deal counts as **sourced by you** if:

 

* You initiated the lead (cold call, walk\-in, networking, outbound email/DM, referral you generated), and

* You logged the lead first in the company pipeline/CRM, and

* You obtained real contact info and the decision\-maker path (not scraped lists)

 

**Does NOT count as sourced by you:**

 

* Inbound leads from the website/ads unless assigned to you

* Leads already in the CRM/pipeline before you logged them

 

Protection Period

 

If you log and introduce a lead, you receive credit for deals that close within **90 days** of your first logged contact (unless the lead was already owned/assigned).

 

Clawback

 

If the client payment is refunded/charged back within the agreed window (typically 30–60 days), the commission is reversed.

 

What You Must Collect (Minimum Lead Info)

 

Every booked lead must include:

 

* Full name \+ company name

* Phone number \+ email

* Industry \+ location

* Pain point (what problem they want solved)

* What they need (AI agent, website, portal/admin, automation)

* Timeline (ASAP / 30–60 / 90 days)

* Decision\-maker confirmation and best time to meet

 

Requirements

 

* Confident speaking with business owners/decision\-makers

* Comfortable prospecting in person and/or by phone

* Strong follow\-up habits and basic organization

* Professional communication and reliability

* Transportation (if doing in\-person outreach)

* Ability to log leads accurately and consistently

 

**Preferred (not required):**

 

* Experience in B2B sales, appointment setting, cold calling, or door\-to\-door

* Familiarity with selling services like marketing, web dev, SaaS, or automation

 

What Success Looks Like (First 30–60 Days)

 

* Consistent daily outreach activity

* A steady pipeline of qualified prospects

* Regular booked meetings with decision\-makers

* Closed deals attributed to your sourced leads

 

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Catering & Events Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
**Catering \& Events Sales Specialist (Remote / Hybrid)**

 

**Mellow Mushroom (Chantilly)** **Job Type:** Full\-time **Compensation:** Base Salary \+ Aggressive Commission Structure (NO CAP)

 

**Are you a "Hunter"? Do you love building relationships but hate being stuck in an office?**

 

Mellow Mushroom Chantilly is looking for a driven **Catering \& Events Sales Specialist** to act as the engine of our off\-premise business. We aren't looking for an Operations Manager to run the kitchen, and we aren't looking for an Office Admin to file paperwork.

 

We are looking for a **Sales Professional** who wants to get out into the community (physically and digitally) and drive revenue.

 

**The Perk:** This position is **primarily remote.** You manage your own schedule. As long as the sales are coming in and the clients are happy, where you work is up to you.

 

**The Mission:**

 

Your goal is simple: **Fill the Calendar.** You will act as the face of Mellow Mushroom to the local business community, medical offices, schools, and event venues. You will nurture our existing loyal clients and aggressively pursue new business.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* **Business Development (The Hunt):** Identify and pursue new catering opportunities. This includes cold\-calling, dropping off tastings to medical offices/businesses, and networking with local organizations.

* **Account Management (The Farm):** Nurture our top existing clients. Ensure our "regulars" feel VIP status and order consistently.

* **Communication Hub:** You are the bridge between the client and the kitchen. Since you are remote, your communication must be over\-the\-top excellent. You are responsible for ensuring the Kitchen Manager and GM know exactly what is happening, when it's happening, and what the guest expects. You are not a "lone wolf"—you are the Quarterback of the catering team.

* **Order Management:** Manage all inquiries via email, phone, and third\-party platforms (like ezCater). Ensure every detail is perfect before handing the order off to the restaurant team for execution.

* **Community Engagement:** Represent the brand at local events or chamber meetings to keep Mellow top\-of\-mind.

 

**The "In\-Office" Requirement:**

 

While this is a remote sales role, you are a critical part of the Mellow Mushroom family.

 

* **Weekly Sync:** One brief weekly meeting with the GM to review sales and upcoming events.

* **Big Events:** Occasional on\-site presence may be required for large\-scale VIP catering setups to ensure quality control and support the team.

 

**Who We Are Looking For:**

 

* **A Self\-Starter:** You don't need a boss looking over your shoulder to get work done. You are disciplined and motivated by the hustle.

* **A Team Player:** Even from home, you are part of the squad. You check in, you communicate, and you care about the team executing your orders.

* **A People Person:** You can talk to anyone, from a pharmaceutical rep to a construction foreman, and make them feel taken care of.

* **Organized:** You can manage a calendar, invoices, and customer follow\-ups without letting details slip through the cracks.

 

**Qualifications:**

 

* **Experience:** Proven experience in Sales, Account Management, or Business Development is preferred.

* **Restaurant Experience:** Helpful, but **not required.** If you know how to sell and build relationships, we can teach you the pizza business.

* **Tech:** Proficient with email, spreadsheets, and CRM tools.

 

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

 

* **Base Salary:** **$32,000 \- $35,000 per year (Guaranteed Base).**

* **90\-Day Ramp\-Up Guarantee:** We offer a **$1,500/month Commission Guarantee** for your first 3 months. This provides income stability while you learn our systems and build your pipeline.

* **Commission:** Aggressive, uncapped commission structure paid on **TOTAL Sales Volume** (not just growth). You earn commission on every qualified order starting at dollar one.

* **Total Earning Potential:** A successful Sales Specialist in this role is expected to earn **$60,000 \- $70,000\+ total annually** (Base \+ Commission). The sky is the limit—if you bring in the business, you get paid for it.

* **Benefits:** Health \& Dental Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Dining Benefits.

* **Flexibility:** Real work/life balance with a flexible, remote schedule.

 

*Mellow Mushroom is an equal\-opportunity employer.*

 

Job Type: Full\-time

 

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* Dental insurance

* Employee discount

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* Paid training

 

Experience:

 

* Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
NorthStar Agents — Sales Representative (Commission\-Only)

 

**Role Title:** Sales Representative (In\-Person \& Phone)

**Job Type:** 100% Commission\-Only (No base pay)

**Location:** Flexible (in\-person preferred; phone/remote allowed)

**Reports To:** NorthStar Agents Leadership

**Compensation:** Paid only on deals you close that are collected

 

About NorthStar Agents

 

NorthStar Agents builds secure, human\-governed AI\-assisted systems for businesses and regulated environments. We deliver high\-impact solutions such as custom websites, partner portals, admin panels, workflow automations, integrations, and AI phone agents.

 

Role Summary

 

We’re hiring a commission\-only Sales Representative to generate and close new business for NorthStar Agents. You can sell **in person or over the phone**—whatever works—so long as you **close deals**. This role is best for someone who can prospect, qualify, present value, handle objections, and close.

 

**Important:** You only get paid by closing and collecting. There is **no salary, hourly pay, or guaranteed draw**.

 

What You’ll Sell

 

* Custom websites and web rebuilds

* Partner portals \+ admin panels (connected systems)

* Workflow automations and business integrations

* AI phone agents (receptionist \+ sales/appointment agents)

* Ongoing monthly maintenance/support packages

 

Responsibilities

 

* Prospect and generate leads (walk\-ins, door\-to\-door, networking, referrals, cold calling, email/DM outreach—your choice)

* Identify decision\-makers and qualify opportunities (need, timeline, budget, fit)

* Present NorthStar Agents solutions clearly and professionally

* Run discovery calls or in\-person pitches and propose next steps

* Close deals and obtain signed agreements

* Maintain a simple pipeline with follow\-ups and status updates

* Coordinate a clean handoff to the delivery team after closing

* Represent NorthStar Agents professionally in\-person and on calls

 

Compensation (Commission\-Only)

 

**You are paid only when the client pays. No base pay.**

 

Commission Structure

 

* **20% commission on one\-time project revenue collected**

* Examples: build fees, setup/implementation fees, project fees.

* **6% commission on Monthly Maintenance Revenue (MRC) collected**

 

**MRC is the client’s monthly maintenance fee** paid to NorthStar Agents for ongoing support/updates/monitoring and related services.Payout Terms

 

* Commission is calculated on **net revenue collected** (after refunds/chargebacks).

* **One\-time commission** is paid after funds clear (or per milestone if the agreement is milestone\-based).

* **MRC commission** is paid monthly as the maintenance fee is collected, typically for the **first 12 months** the account remains active and in good standing.

 

Example

 

Client closes on a **$10,000 build** with **$500/month maintenance**:

 

* One\-time commission: 20% of $10,000 \= **$2,000**

* MRC commission: 6% of $500 \= **$30/month** (paid monthly while collected, up to 12 months)

 

Requirements

 

* Proven ability (or strong confidence) selling services and closing

* Comfortable speaking with business owners/decision\-makers

* Able to sell in person and/or by phone

* Strong follow\-up habits and basic organization (pipeline tracking)

* Professional communication, appearance, and reliability

* Reliable transportation (if doing in\-person outreach)

* Phone \+ email access for outreach and follow\-ups

 

**Preferred (not required):**

 

* Experience selling marketing, web development, SaaS, automation, or business services

* Experience selling to restaurants, retail, medical, or appointment\-based businesses

 

What Success Looks Like (First 30–60 Days)

 

* Consistent outbound activity and follow\-up cadence

* Steady pipeline of qualified leads

* Closed/won deals with signed agreements and collected payments

* Clean handoffs with accurate scope and expectations

 

Pay: $79,920\.59 \- $96,248\.46 per year

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Bookkeeper / Administrative Support (Independent Contractor)

 

**Foundations Alaska, LLC** is seeking a detail\-oriented and dependable **Bookkeeper / Administrative Support Contractor** to support financial and administrative operations. This role requires accuracy, discretion, and experience handling sensitive financial and compliance\-related information.

 

Responsibilities

 

* Perform bookkeeping functions, including accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, and financial record maintenance

* Maintain organized and secure filing systems, including digital document management and backups

* Review internal billing and invoices for accuracy, completeness, and compliance

* Assist with compliance reviews and audit preparation, including Medicaid\-related documentation as applicable

* Coordinate with organizational leadership and external partners, including the Company’s CPA

* Provide general administrative and office support related to financial and operational functions

 

Time Tracking \& Availability

 

* All billable hours must be tracked using the Company\-approved time tracking and productivity monitoring application, **Insightful**

* Hours not tracked through Insightful require prior written approval and may not be eligible for payment

* **Must be available for communication between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM PST**, Monday through Friday, to support coordination and timely responses

 

Qualifications

 

* Prior experience in bookkeeping and/or administrative support required

* Proficiency with accounting software (QuickBooks preferred)

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

* Experience in regulated, compliance\-driven, or audit environments preferred

 

Confidentiality, Background, and Reference Checks

 

This position involves access to confidential financial, organizational, and personal information related to the Company and individuals it serves.

 

* Strict confidentiality and data protection standards are required

* **Background checks and professional reference checks are required** and may be ongoing as a condition of engagement

 

Position Type

 

* Independent Contractor

* Remote

* Part\-time / Flexible hours (with required availability window noted above)

 

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates must email a **resume and cover letter** to:

**connect@foundationsalaska.org**

 

Job Type: Part\-time

 

Pay: $23\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

jobs.title: Visiting Dermatology NP/PA
jobs.description:
Job description

 

Main Street Dermatology is looking for an experienced, hard working nurse practitioner or physician assistant who is passionate about caring for seniors and providing exceptional dermatology care. Bonus points if you have visiting medical or home health experience!

 

What is Main Street Dermatology?

 

Reminiscent of the medical house call days, Main Street Dermatology is the only visiting medical dermatology company serving residents in senior living communities in Michigan. We focus on specialized, age\-friendly care and preventative treatments to minimize the need for invasive procedures and ER visits. We partner with senior community staff, family members and other health care providers to provide the most comprehensive care experience.

 

Main Street Dermatology, which offers high quality and compassionate care to older adults, is rooted in both a strong educational foundation and valuable dermatology experience. Main Street Dermatology is focused on growth and becoming the \#1 leader and advocate in the field of geriatric dermatology in the near future.

 

Why Main Street Dermatology?

 

Rewarding opportunity to focus on an underserved population and push traditional healthcare boundaries.

 

* Comprehensive geriatric dermatology training.

* Flexible “out of the medical office” schedule.

* Lucrative compensation based on receipt of collections.

* In\-house admin support (for appointment scheduling, insurance verification, billing, etc.).

* Medical equipment and supplies provided.

* Innovative business model empowering APPs to practice to their full scope.

* Start\-up with multiple career growth opportunities in an entrepreneurial setting.

 

Responsibilities and Duties:

 

After satisfactory completion of geriatric dermatology training, daily duties and responsibilities include traveling to independent living, assisted living, memory care and nursing home communities to provide medical dermatology care. An additional responsibility is partnering with and maintaining relationships with patients, families, senior living community staff and other health care providers to ensure success. Patient care duties include physical assessments, diagnosis and treatment of a variety of dermatological disorders and performing procedures. A strong foundation in patient and family counseling is necessary. An entrepreneurial spirit with motivation to grow the assigned territory is imperative. Providers must complete timely documentation in the EMR.

 

Requirements:

 

* Comfortable with an independent contractor 1099 position.

* Comfortable with 100% collection\-based pay structure

* Entrepreneurial spirit with a growth mindset.

* Willing to travel on\-site to senior living communities in wind, rain or snow!

* 2 years\+ NP/PA experience.

* Valid Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant license.

* Valid Board Certification.

* So much love for senior living residents!

 

Job Types: Part\-time, Contract

 

Pay: From $75\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 12 per week

 

Experience:

 

* NP/PA: 1 year (Required)

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Clarkston, MI 48346

jobs.title: Client Account Manager & Advisory Lead (CPA Firm)
jobs.description:
**Part\-Time to Start \| Remote (Canada preferred) \| No Overtime \| Client\-Facing Leadership Role**

 

We’re a U.S.\-based boutique CPA firm serving a small, high\-quality book of growth\-stage and high\-net\-worth clients. Our niche spans **real estate, e\-commerce, and service\-based businesses**, with year\-round tax planning for monthly clients—not just compliance at tax time.

 

2025 has been our strongest year yet, and we’re hiring a **Client Account Manager \& Advisory Lead** to help run day\-to\-day client operations, lead client projects, and maintain the high bar our clients expect.

 

This role reports **directly to the firm owner** and works alongside a highly capable admin team. You’ll be the steady, senior presence ensuring clients feel supported, work is delivered cleanly, and nothing falls through the cracks.

 

Why This Role Exists

 

As we grow, we need someone who can:

 

* Own client relationships end\-to\-end

* Keep projects moving smoothly across an international team

* Provide strong domain guidance on tax and accounting matters

* Maintain quality and accountability without chaos or overtime

 

This is **not** a high\-volume firm and **not** a burnout culture. We value **humility, care, integrity, and clear communication**—with clients and internally.

 

What You’ll DoClient Ownership \& Advisory (40%)

 

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.

* Lead client calls, set agendas, explain deliverables, and manage follow\-ups.

* Proactively manage client expectations and keep the owner informed of key developments.

* Identify planning opportunities and coordinate year\-round tax planning for monthly clients.

* Translate technical work into clear, client\-ready guidance.

 

Project \& Workflow Management (30%)

 

* Own client projects from start to finish across tax, accounting, and advisory work.

* Coordinate with team members across the U.S., India, and the Philippines.

* Ensure deadlines are met, scopes are clear, and handoffs are clean.

* Work closely with admin support while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

 

Review \& Quality Control (20%)

 

* Review U.S. individual and business tax returns (including partnerships and real estate activity).

* Review tax\-ready bookkeeping (QBO/Xero) and ensure accuracy and consistency.

* Sign off on reviewed work and take ownership of quality.

* Provide clear review notes and domain guidance to the team.

 

Systems \& Process Improvement (10%)

 

* Improve client workflows, checklists, and internal systems.

* Help build scalable processes without over\-engineering.

* Act as an integrator who sees where things break and fixes them.

 

Who We’re Looking ForMust\-Haves

 

* CPA (U.S. or Canada) or equivalent public\-practice experience.

* 6–10 years in tax, accounting, or client advisory in public practice.

* Strong working knowledge of **U.S. tax returns** (individual and entity).

* Comfortable with real estate clients, small businesses, and HNW individuals.

* Excellent people skills—calm, clear, and confident with clients.

* Self\-starter who takes ownership and follows things through.

* Meticulous attention to detail and comfort being accountable for signed\-off work.

* Experience working with distributed or international teams.

* Familiarity with cloud workflows (TaxDome or similar).

 

Nice\-to\-Haves

 

* Mandarin or Cantonese (many clients are Chinese\-speaking).

* Experience with real estate, e\-commerce, or service\-based businesses.

* Experience acting as an “integrator” or operations lead.

 

Work Environment \& Culture

 

* **No overtime. Ever.**

* Small, intentional client book.

* Year\-round tax planning—not seasonal chaos.

* Remote\-first team across multiple countries.

* High standards, low ego.

* We value people who are steady, thoughtful, and kind.

 

Hours \& Compensation

 

* Part\-time to start: \~20–25 hours/week, with room to grow.

* Remote: Canadian Candidate and H\-1B sponsorship may be considered for the right candidate.

* Base hourly or salary compensation (commensurate with experience).

* **Incentive compensation tied to client retention and upsells.**

* PTO and sick time after probation.

 

How Success Is Measured

 

* Clients feel supported, informed, and confident.

* Projects move smoothly without last\-minute surprises.

* Work is accurate, reviewed, and delivered cleanly.

* The owner has clarity—not fire drills.

* Systems get better over time.

 

Who This Is For

 

This role is a great fit if you:

 

* Take ownership and follow things through without being chased

* Are calm, thoughtful, and confident with clients

* Care deeply about accuracy and quality

* Enjoy improving systems and client experience

* Want a senior role **without burnout**

 

Who Should NOT Apply

 

This role is **not** a fit if you:

 

* Thrive on urgency, chaos, or constant fire drills

* Believe long hours \= commitment

* Prefer being told exactly what to do rather than owning outcomes

* Avoid client conversations or difficult discussions

* Dislike being accountable for work you sign off on

* Want a large client book or high\-volume compliance environment

 

Job Type: Part\-time

 

Pay: From $60\.00 per hour

 

Expected hours: 20 per week

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k) 3% Match

* Life insurance

* Paid time off

* Work from home

 

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Licensed Psychologist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

 

Nowlogy Psychology Experts of Hastings is hiring one or two exceptional doctoral\-level Psychologists (PhD/PsyD) who want something better than the usual private\-practice grind or big\-system burnout.

 

This is a great hybrid opportunity (part\-time or full\-time) that lets you:

 

· Focus 100% on clinical work you love (therapy \& evidence\-based assessment)

 

· See the number of clients that feels sustainable and fulfilling to YOU

 

· Earn significantly more than traditional private practice (we handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and all the admin)

 

· Work alongside other doctor\-level colleagues in a collaborative, intellectually rich environment

 

Our ideal colleagues are APA\-trained, MN licensed (or license\-eligible) psychologists with an E\-Passport (or eligible) and clear expertise in at least one specialty area.

 

If you’ve been in independent practice and are tired of wearing every hat…or you’re coming from a large system and miss having time to actually think, breathe, and do your best work…this could be the move you’ve been waiting for.

 

Join our team of dedicated psychologists committed to making a positive impact on the lives of our clients through compassionate care and evidence\-based practices.

 

**Responsibilities \& Opportunities**

 

· Opportunities to provide individual therapy, group therapy, couples and family therapy, assessments, and supervision of post\-doctoral fellows.

 

· Offer specialized care for clients with general presenting problems as well as your area of expertise. At our Hastings clinic we see many individuals seeking support for trauma, anxiety, depression, relational concerns, OCD, and school challenges.

 

· Develop strong rapport with clients

 

· Maintain accurate records and documentation.

 

· Utilize telehealth platforms to reach clients who may benefit from remote services.

 

· Stay current with best practices in psychology and ongoing learning opportunities through continuous education and professional development.

 

**Work Environment**

 

Enjoy a work atmosphere that is warm, cozy, open, supportive, balanced, and calm. The goal is to support professionals in building the work and life balance that best fits their needs. There are opportunities for formal and informal consultation, growth, learning, developing your passions, and trying new things.

 

Hastings, MN is a beautiful city on the southeastern edge of the Twin Cities metro. We serve clients that commute to us from the cities as well as the local rural population. Hastings has a small\-town feel combined with bigger city amenities (coffee shops, restaurants, retail, riverwalk). Hastings is a short commute from multiple desirable cities to call home (if you choose not to call Hastings home that is!), including Cottage Grove, Woodbury, Red Wing, and Rosemount.

 

**Qualifications**

 

· Ph.D. or Psy.D. in Counseling or Clinical Psychology from an accredited institution (U.S. or Canada)

 

· Licensed or eligible for licensure in Minnesota

 

· Eligible for the PsyPact APIT and E\-Passport

 

**Required Skills**

 

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills

 

· Ability to work independently and as part of a team

 

· Proficiency in telehealth technology

 

**Preferred Skills**

 

· Experience working with children ages 3\-16

 

· Experience with diverse client populations

 

· Specialization in trauma\-informed care

 

**Job Information**

 

Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract

 

Pay (full\-time): $120,000 \- $140,000 per year

 

Benefits (full\-time or part\-time):

 

· Flexible schedule

 

· PTO \& Holidays

 

· Health insurance

 

Work Location: Hastings, MN with option for work\-from\-home days

 

**How To Apply**

 

Apply on Indeed or email katevanpay@nowlogy.com (clinic owner) with your CV and a quick note about what you’re looking for right now. Happy to hop on a 15\-minute call and talk more!

 

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

 

Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* Dental insurance

* Flexible schedule

* Health insurance

* Paid time off

* Relocation assistance

* Vision insurance

 

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hastings, MN 55033

jobs.title: NetSuite Architect / Senior Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**Full job description**

 

**About the Role**

 

We are seeking a **NetSuite Architect / Senior Functional Consultant** to lead the design, configuration, and ongoing optimization of NetSuite environments supporting **US\-based operations**.

 

This is **not** an entry\-level admin role. You will own **solution architecture, functional design, reporting strategy, and system scalability**, working closely with finance, operations, and technical stakeholders.

 

You will also collaborate with AI\-assisted development and offshore technical resources to accelerate build\-outs.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Act as **functional architect** for NetSuite implementations and enhancements

* Design and configure:

* Chart of Accounts

* Subsidiaries, Classes, Locations

* Custom fields, forms, workflows

* Saved Searches, KPIs, dashboards, reports

* Translate business processes into **scalable NetSuite solutions**

* Partner with stakeholders to define **requirements, user journeys, and reporting needs**

* Oversee and guide:

* SuiteScript developers

* Integration work (APIs, middleware, external systems)

* Ensure data integrity, performance, and best\-practice configurations

* Support system rollouts, user training, and documentation

* Troubleshoot complex NetSuite issues across finance and operations

 

**Required Qualifications**

 

* **5\+ years** of hands\-on NetSuite experience

* Proven experience as:

* Senior NetSuite Consultant

* NetSuite Architect

* ERP Functional Lead

* Deep functional knowledge of:

* GL, AP, AR

* Multi\-subsidiary / multi\-entity setups

* Financial reporting and dashboards

* Strong experience with:

* Saved Searches (advanced formulas)

* Workflows

* Custom records and fields

* Ability to **design solutions**, not just follow instructions

* Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken)

* Comfortable working **US time zones** (partial overlap required)

 

**Nice to Have (Strong Plus)**

 

* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, ERP Consultant, SuiteFoundation)

* Experience with:

* SuiteScript (even if not primary coder)

* Integrations (REST/SOAP, Celigo, Boomi, etc.)

* Experience supporting:

* Real estate

* Construction

* Professional services

* Multi\-entity finance structures

* Prior experience working with **US companies or MSPs**

 

**Compensation (Indian Market)**

 

* ₹**197,000 –** ₹**251,000\+ per month**, depending on experience

* Performance\-based increases

* Long\-term role with growth into **Lead Architect / Head of NetSuite**

 

*(Exceptional candidates supporting heavy US workloads may be paid above local market.)*

 

**Work Setup**

 

* Fully remote (Philippines)

* Full\-time

* Stable, long\-term engagement

* High ownership, low micromanagement

 

**Who This Role Is NOT For**

 

* Entry\-level NetSuite admins

* Pure data entry or ticket\-only support roles

* Candidates without architecture or solution\-design experience

 

Pay: $113,296\.47 \- $136,443\.06 per year

 

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: BCBA - Board Certified Behavior Analyst (Clinical Director)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THIS JOB:**

 

We are seeking a passionate Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to lead our brand\-new facility in Pompano Beach. This is an exciting opportunity for a clinician who is dedicated to making a lasting impact on the lives of children with autism and their families, while driving a culture of clinical excellence.

 

You Focus on Clinical Work – We Handle the Admin work

 

* BCBAs do not create or manage staff scheduling, do HR tasks, or insurance chasing

* Clinical Directors have a MAX caseload of 12 full\-time clients (or max of 40 billable hours per week).

* Practicum students and interns assist your caseload.

* You’ll do assessments, supervise treatment plans, train RBTs, and provide parent training

 

**WHY BCBAS LOVE WORKING WITH US:**

 

True Work\-Life Balance

 

* Work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

* No nights, no weekends, no on\-call duties.

* Paid Time Off

 

**BENEFITS:**

 

* Salary $80,000\-$90,000 (depending on experience)

* 401k

* 10 days paid time off per year (Because you deserve it!)

* 10 days paid holidays per year

* Unlimited unpaid days off

* Company paid BLS / CPR certification

* Company paid QBS Safety certification

* Company paid CEUs

* Performance Reviews every 6 months

 

Supported, Not Micromanaged

 

* Owners are not involved in clinical decisions

* SOS provides live remote BCBA support and clinical training from the Franchising Team

* SOS has a LMS with robust training content for RBTs and BCBAs. SOS gives BTs access to the 40 hour cert videos on their first day of work.

* All BCBAs get two weeks of initial training from our corporate office \- for this, you may have to travel to Houston for 1 week.

 

Ethically Aligned

 

* SOS was founded by an autism parent.

* 25% of SOS owners are autism parents who prioritize care over profit.

* SOS does not require employees to sign non\-compete agreements.

* SOS does not require training payback agreements.

* SOS is proud to have full billing transparency. Nothing gets billed to insurance without BCBA approval.

* To ensure the highest standards of care, our corporate office conducts a positive, supportive Quality and Compliance Audit every six months—providing each clinic with valuable feedback, resources, and guidance to help us continually grow and serve our families even better.

 

Career Growth

 

* Leadership and mentorship opportunities available

* Opportunities for you to move up to Regional Director as your employer opens new locations.

* Option of transferring to a different location, in the event that you need to move away.

* If you ever want to retire from clinical work, you will have the unique opportunity to open your own franchise!

 

**ABOUT SOS:**

 

Success On The Spectrum (SOS) is the largest and fastest\-growing autism treatment franchise in the U.S., founded by an autism mom and fueled by purpose. Unlike corporate\-run ABA companies owned by private equity firms, each SOS clinic is individually owned, with a commitment to quality care over profits. Our play\-based model emphasizes NET, so we take clients on field trips! We also encourage high parent involvement and allow parents to watch their child’s therapy live from our parent viewing room!

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

 

Benefits:

 

* 401(k)

* 401(k) matching

* Continuing education credits

* Paid time off

 

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Proposal Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Proposal Manager

 

**Overview**

  • ------------

    •  

     

    Company Overview:

     

     

    Allied Universal®, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

     

    **Job Description**

  • -------------------

    •  

     

    Allied Universal® is hiring a Senior Proposal Manager. The Senior Proposal Manager coordinates and directs the organizations large and complex responses for Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs) support to the business development team in the US and for US outbound global opportunities. The Senior Proposal Manager organizes and reviews all customer provided documents, develops project timelines, assigns responsibilities, tracks, and manages all required deliverables to ensure deadlines are met with desired quality, and provides pre\- and post\-sale support. The Senior Proposal manager analyzes customer needs and business drivers; collaborates with cross\-functional resources to gather and synthesize compelling business and technical content and input. The Senior proposal manager reviews, creates and coordinates written responses that effectively communicate the value of our integrated solutions while identifying and resolving critical issues. In addition to leading project teams the Senior Proposal Manager also researches and writes new content for the shared library and assists on occasion in the development of sales presentations.

     

    * **Remote Flexibility**: Work from anywhere while collaborating with international teams in a fast\-paced environment.

    * **Lead Strategic Proposals**: Drive large, complex RFP and RFI responses that shape major business opportunities.

    * **Global Impact**: Support U.S. and outbound global clients, influencing high\-value deals across multiple markets.

     

    **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

     

     

    * Review and analyze customer\-defined scope and requirements for proposal requests (e.g., RFI, RFP)

    * Work with sales lead to determine key win themes and strategy

    * Project manage the proposal process ensuring that all required elements are adequately addressed

    * Create, collect, edit, proofread, organize, format, review drafts and finalize proposals for readability, consistent messaging, thought leadership, responsiveness and compliance with customer requirements and AUS business practices

    * Coordinate with US and international offices, Subject Matter Experts, and Headquarters departments to develop appropriate responses

    * Assist with follow up activities for sales opportunities ensuring that all follow\-on requests are dealt with on a timely and professional basis

    * Review proposals for other proposal managers and provide relevant feedback

    * Develop new material and update existing material for proposal library

    * Assist with creation of presentation material

    * Assist with proposal system administrative duties

    * Identify, recommend, document, communicate and train on proposal best practices, policies, processes, and procedures

     

    **QUALIFICATIONS:**

     

     

    * Bachelor's Degree in English, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or related field

    * Minimum of seven (7\) years of relevant work experience in sales/proposal development

    * Minimum of five (5\) years of writing work experience

    * Superior written and verbal communication skills, including editing/proofreading for grammar, style, spelling, punctuation, word usage, and one voice

    * Excellent computer skills with an expert level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Word, with advanced knowledge of formatting and editing

    * Demonstrated experience managing projects with multiple stakeholders and under tight deadlines

     

    **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

     

     

    * Experience as an admin or working with proposal software systems (e.g., Loopio, RFPIO, SmartDocs)

    * Experience with content management systems (e.g., Seismic, Highspot)

    * Basic InDesign, Photoshop and/or graphics experience

     

    **BENEFITS:**

     

    * Base Wage $80,000 \- $90,000 \+ bonus eligibility \+ internal advancement opportunities

    * Medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, basic life, AD\&D, and disability insurance

    * Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days

    * Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3\.08 hours biweekly. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

     

     

    \#LI\-BB1

     

    **Closing**

  • -----------

    •  

     

    Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

     

     

    If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

     

    **Requisition ID**

  • ------------------

    •  

     

     

    2025\-1497390

**Location:** UCHealth Admin Lowry, US:CO: Denver

 

 

 

**Department:** UCHlth Research Admin

**Shift:** Days

 

 

 

 

**Pay:** $22\.80 \- $29\.64 / hour. Pay is dependent on applicant's relevant experience

 

 

 

Summary:

 

Coordinates activities and flow of work for an assigned function or area. This is a 100% remote position. Qualified out\-of\-state candidates may be considered.

 

 

 

 

Responsibilities:

 

Prioritizes multiple tasks and projects to ensure timely completion. Delegates and assigns work commensurate with knowledge, skill and experience, and ensures the work is performed appropriately.

 

 

 

Collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to assist with problem identification and resolution, cost containment issues, implementation of new services, and systems/performance measures.

 

 

 

Facilitates the development, implementation and evaluation of program or area services and initiatives. Facilitates the development of practice standards and measurable outcomes based on performance evaluation and research.

 

 

 

Serves as a resource to staff regarding departmental/area policies, procedures and services.

 

 

 

Within scope of job, requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgement and the ability to work with minimal supervision. Must be able to work in a fast\-paced environment and take appropriate action.

 

 

 

**Requirements:**

 

* Minimum Required Education: High School diploma or GED.

* Minimum Experience: 2 years administrative experience.

 

 

 

Employees are our number one asset.

 

 

 

UCHealth promotes a culture that invests in professional success and personal well\-being through a comprehensive total rewards program. \*

 

 

 

Recognition

 

* Performance bonus: UCHealth offers a 3\-Year Incentive Bonus to recognize employee contributions to our success in quality, patient experience, organizational growth, financial goals and tenure. The bonus accumulates annually each October and is paid out in October during the third year of employment.

* Performance\-based pay increase: The Annual Merit Pay Increase recognizes work performance that meets or consistently exceeds performance standards documented through UCHealth's established evaluation process and accounts for increased experience, skills and cost of living.

* Market reviews: All UCHealth positions are reviewed annually to ensure UCHealth base pay aligns with market standards. Base pay rates are adjusted as needed to stay market competitive.

 

 

 

Health and well\-being

 

* Medical, dental and vision coverage.

* Access to 24/7 mental health and well\-being support for employees and dependents.

* Discounted gym memberships and fitness resources.

* Free Care.com membership.

* Voluntary benefits such as accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal plan, identity theft protection, pet insurance, auto and home insurance, and employee discount programs.

* Time away from work: Paid time off (PTO), paid family and medical leave (inclusive of Colorado FAMLI), leaves of absence.

* + New employees receive an initial PTO load with first paycheck.

* Employer\-provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment coverage with buy\-up coverage options.

* Employer\-provided short\-term disability and long\-term disability with a buy\-up coverage option.

 

 

 

Retirement and savings

 

* 403(b) plan with employer matching contribution.

* Additional 457(b) plan may be available.

* Flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent day care; health savings account available when enrolled in high\-deductible (HD) medical plan.

 

 

 

Education and career growth

 

* UCHealth provides access to academic degrees and certificate programs to promote professional and personal growth.

* + Up to 100% of tuition, books and fees paid for by UCHealth for specific educational degrees.

+ Other programs may qualify for up to $10,000/year pre\-paid by UCHealth or up to $5,250/year in the form of tuition reimbursement.

* Access to LinkedIn Learning, which offers thousands of virtual courses and seminars, and internal professional development opportunities.

* Employees have access to free assistance navigating the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program and submitting their federal student loans for forgiveness.

 

 

 

* Eligibility for some programs is based on an employee's scheduled work hours.

 

 

 

We improve lives. In big ways through learning, healing, and discovery. In small, personal ways through human connection. But in all ways, we improve lives.

 

 

 

 

UCHealth always welcomes talent. This position will be open for a minimum of three days and until a top applicant is identified.

 

 

 

UCHealth recognizes and appreciates the rich array of talents and perspectives that equal employment and diversity can offer our institution. As an equal opportunity employer, UCHealth is committed to making all employment decisions based on valid requirements. No applicant shall be discriminated against in ay terms, conditions or privileges of employment or otherwise be discriminated against because of the individual's race, color, national origin, language, culture, ethnicity, age, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender, veteran status, socioeconomic status, or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state, or local law. UCHealth does not discriminate against any qualified applicant with a disability as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act and will make reasonable accommodations, when the do not impose an undue hardship on the organization.

This position is an onsite role and does not offer a hybrid or remote option

 

 

 

**Summary:**

 

 

 

We are seeking a seasoned Program Director with strong project management expertise to lead a complex, multi\-department rollout. The ideal candidate will oversee projects from planning through execution, ensuring timely delivery within budget while adhering to best practices and methodologies such as waterfall, iterative, and agile. This role requires exceptional leadership and collaboration skills to build relationships across divisions and executive teams, drive strategic initiatives, and improve operational efficiency. The candidate will manage day\-to\-day program operations, implement effective processes, report outcomes, and foster transparent communication. Additionally, they will identify opportunities for continuous improvement and lead change management efforts to enhance project delivery.

 

 

 

**Responsibilities:**

 

* Provide advanced support for behavioral health and social work programs across the system. Provide system standardization, strategic planning, and project management in coordination with departments involved with, and impacted by, behavioral health programs.

* Assist with developing specific departmental goals, standards, and objectives which directly support the strategic plan and vision of the organization. Monitor departmental budgets, regulatory compliance, departmental contracts, and vendor relations. Oversee projects; ensure departmental alignment; support governance structure.

* Implement and maintain solutions that support the strategies of the behavioral health service line

* Provide analysis and needs assessments for the community and other behavioral health partners both inside and outside the organization including grant opportunities. Respond to internal inquiries about programs, coordinate activities with cross\-functional partners, and perform program related special projects and business analysis as needed.

* 5 years of relevant experience.

* Discounted gym memberships and fitness resources.

* Free Care.com membership.

* Voluntary benefits such as accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal plan, identity theft protection, pet insurance, auto and home insurance, and employee discount programs.

* Time away from work: Paid time off, paid family and medical leave (inclusive of Colorado FAMLI), leaves of absence.

* + New employees receive an initial PTO load with first paycheck.

* Employer\-provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment coverage with buy\-up coverage options.

* Employer\-provided short\-term disability and long\-term disability with a buy\-up coverage option.

 

 

 

Retirement and savings

 

* 403(b) plan with employer matching contribution.

* Additional 457(b) plan may be available.

* Flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent care; health savings accounts available when enrolled in high\-deductible medical plan.

 

 

 

Education and career growth

* + Up to 100% of tuition, books and fees paid for by UCHealth for specific educational degrees.
